dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based system used in Japanese medical clinics. Program SEIKYU1903 handles local public expense (地方公費) duplicate/complex receipt processing.
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files typical of ORCA
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (レセプト/receipt) system - specifically local public expense (地方公費) mountain/complex receipt processing for JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software
purpose.summary: This program (SEIKYU1903) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It processes local public expense (地方公費) billing receipts, handling patient insurance information, payment collection data, and generating printed receipt documents. It reads indexed files, processes patient and insurance combination records, and outputs formatted billing receipts.

notable_features: UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for batch parameter passing
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access
REDEFINES usage for hospital name/address fields
OCCURS tables for insurance combination data
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
